author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: These parsers read audit logs from OpenAI API Platform organizations. The audit logs API is pull only, so bridges/ai-compliance-logs in this repo sends each object as one JSON record to HTTP Ingest. Login and logout events go to Auth, and every other event type goes to ManagementEvent.
notes:
Setup:
- An organization owner turns on audit logging (Data controls > Data retention) and creates an Admin key.
- The audit logs API is pull only, so records need a bridge to reach Sophos NG-SIEM: send each object from data[] as one JSON record to an HTTP Ingest integration in Sophos Fusion.
- bridges/ai-compliance-logs in this repo does that.

Field mapping:
- login and logout events go to Auth.
- Every other event type (API keys, projects, users, invites, roles, groups, service accounts, rate limits, IP allowlists, SCIM, certificates, organization and tenant changes) goes to ManagementEvent, with the event type in operation_name and the event type plus the changed object's ID in operation.
- ManagementEvent has no address field, so the session IP is in host_id; actions by API keys carry no IP.
- OpenAI doesn't document the login.failed error codes, so failures are OTHER_ERROR with the message in extra_failurereason.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples are synthetic, built from the AuditLog schema and examples in OpenAI's OpenAPI spec.

Testing:
- Each parser passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13: 106 of 106 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs, no parser claimed another's lines, and no built-in parser claimed any line.

Known gaps:
- The records carry no prompt or response content.
- No live organization was available, so the parsers are tested against the documented shapes only.
